value: Aldervale serves the public in English and French; every programme document exists in both languages with the same rules.
The desk answers for three programmes: the Home Heating Rebate (HHR), the Child Activity Credit (CAC) and the Senior Transit Pass (STP).
Application references are AV- followed by a letter and four digits, for example AV-K4417.
Application AV-K4502 is waiting for a proof of residence; the applicant was told by letter on 2026-10-12.
Application AV-K4805 was refused for income above the limit; an appeal is possible until 2026-11-21.
The Harbour Service Office (ALV-PORT) closes for renovation from 2026-11-16 to 2026-11-20.
Service offices close on 11 November 2026 for Remembrance Day.
Applications, document uploads and changes of address can be made on the Aldervale online portal at any time.
The Mobile Service Unit (ALV-MOB) visits the northern villages on a monthly route and takes documents and transit pass photos.
Most Home Heating Rebate decisions are made within 25 business days of a complete application.
Senior Transit Pass photos are taken at the Downtown and Harbour offices and by the mobile unit.
Approved rebates and credits are paid by direct deposit to the account on the applicant's file.
Questions about personal information go to the desk's privacy officer through the online portal's contact form.
A refused application can be appealed within 30 days of the decision letter.
The desk never needs a social insurance number in chat; a reference number finds an application.
